program:
:- prefix(ex, 'https://example.org/1428/').
ex:ans(A, B) :- A is 7 // 2, B is 7 / 2.
?- ex:ans(A, B).

provenance.derivation: `//` is truncating integer division (toward zero): 7 / 2 = 3.5, truncated toward zero = 3, so 7 // 2 = 3. `/` is exact rational division: 7/2 stays the exact fraction 7/2 (already lowest terms, gcd(7,2)=1). The two operators over the SAME operands (7, 2) diverge: `//` commits the ℤ value 3, `/` commits the ℚ value 7/2 -- the contrast this case pins.
provenance.note: independently derived; never hand-edited to match the native engine
